image_description: A black, square-shaped jeweler's loupe with a hinged folding mechanism resting on a textured purple surface. The device features a large circular convex lens in the center, surrounded by a black plastic or metal frame. The bottom flap of the case has ornate gold-colored filigree detailing. The lens shows significant greenish reflection and glare.

The reflection on the lens is an opaque, solid green band that does not correspond to a realistic environmental reflection. It looks like a texture paste-over rather than optical refraction/reflection.
The hinge mechanism is vague and lacks clear mechanical definition (pins, barrels). It appears slightly fused with the casing body.
